requirements.description: User explicitly wants the property located near parks. Proximity expressed as 'near', so the threshold is the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74.

User prefers energy class D or better, so the filter includes classes A1 through D. Area (115 sqm), capacity (15 people), location (Turin, near parks), and property type (commercial unit) are not energy columns and are not handled here.

The user explicitly requires at least 115 sqm of gross floor area, so the total surface_area is set as a >= threshold. The 15-person capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-property-area threshold was supplied. Energy class, proximity to parks, and the Turin location are outside the reference columns and are handled by other agents. The commercial-unit typology is not selected because the list of available typologies is empty.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 115 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D') AND green >= 74 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on surface_area >= 115, energy_class in A1-D, green score >= 74, and a 3.0 km haversine radius around 45.0677551, 7.6824892. Results are ordered by distance from that point, nearest first. No other predicates were added.
